products.name: Shimla Apple
products.description: Crisp, juicy red apples from Himachal orchards. Good for snacking, salads and lunch boxes.

products.name: Robusta Banana
products.description: Ripe yellow Robusta bananas with a soft, sweet bite. Sold by the dozen.

products.name: Seedless Green Grapes
products.description: Sweet, seedless green grapes. Rinse just before eating and keep the rest refrigerated.

products.name: Bhagwa Pomegranate
products.description: Deep red Bhagwa pomegranates with juicy arils for salads, raita or fresh juice.

products.name: Allahabad Guava
products.description: Firm, fragrant guavas. Enjoy them plain or with a pinch of salt and chilli.

products.name: Green Pear
products.description: Mild, juicy green pears. Leave at room temperature for a day or two to soften.

products.name: Kiran Watermelon
products.description: Whole Kiran watermelon, roughly 2 to 3 kg each, with sweet red flesh.

products.name: Muskmelon
products.description: Fragrant orange-fleshed muskmelon, roughly 1 kg each. Chill before serving.

products.name: Nagpur Orange
products.description: Easy-to-peel Nagpur oranges with a sweet and tangy taste.

products.name: Mosambi (Sweet Lime)
products.description: Mild, juicy sweet lime, popular for fresh juice.

products.name: Lemon
products.description: Thin-skinned, juicy lemons for cooking, dressings and nimbu pani.

products.name: Alphonso Mango
products.description: Ratnagiri Alphonso mangoes, naturally ripened. Sold by the dozen.

products.name: Queen Pineapple
products.description: Sweet, aromatic Queen pineapple, about 1 kg each.

products.name: Tender Coconut
products.description: Green tender coconut with fresh coconut water and soft malai.

products.name: Red Lady Papaya
products.description: Red-fleshed papaya. Ready to eat when the skin turns mostly yellow.

products.name: Green Kiwi
products.description: Tangy green kiwifruit, three per pack. Currently out of stock.

products.name: Hybrid Tomato
products.description: Firm, red hybrid tomatoes for curries, chutneys and salads.

products.name: Nashik Red Onion
products.description: Medium-sized red onions from Nashik. Store in a cool, dry, airy place.

products.name: Potato
products.description: All-purpose potatoes for curries, fries and sabzi. Keep away from sunlight.

products.name: Green Capsicum
products.description: Glossy green capsicum for stir-fries, pizzas and pulao.

products.name: Cucumber
products.description: Crunchy cucumbers for salads, raita and sandwiches.

products.name: Cauliflower
products.description: Compact white cauliflower head, roughly 500 to 700 g.

products.name: Green Cabbage
products.description: Tight green cabbage head, roughly 700 g to 1 kg.

products.name: Lady's Finger (Okra)
products.description: Tender, young okra pods for bhindi fry and sambar.

products.name: Purple Brinjal
products.description: Glossy purple brinjals for baingan bharta, curries and fries.

products.name: Ooty Carrot
products.description: Sweet, bright orange carrots from the Nilgiris.

products.name: Fresh Ginger
products.description: Aromatic fresh ginger root for tea, curries and pastes.

products.name: Garlic
products.description: Firm garlic bulbs with large cloves.

products.name: Beetroot
products.description: Deep red beetroot for salads, poriyal and juice.

products.name: Sweet Potato
products.description: Sweet potatoes for roasting, boiling or chaat.

products.name: Broccoli
products.description: Fresh green broccoli head, roughly 300 to 400 g.

products.name: Palak (Spinach)
products.description: Tender spinach leaves for palak paneer, dal and soups. Wash well before use.

products.name: Coriander Leaves
products.description: Fragrant coriander bunch for garnishing and chutneys.

products.name: Jamun
products.description: Seasonal jamun. Hidden from the store until the season starts.
